scope: All16 agreement-only, distinct own-character gestures. Generic T03 remains for unchanged other modes.

rows.pose: Observant, notebook and pen close to torso, reserved confident conclusion
Methodical, fingertips to temple and opposite arm support

Playful locksmith Rin confirms her ally with a sly tilted smile and one raised eyebrow. Her torso leans slightly back toward screen-right. Her RIGHT index finger lifts a small ring of THREE metal keys near shoulder height, keys dangling clearly; LEFT hand sits on her hip under her loose yellow jacket. Keep the purple bob and cat mask sitting on top of her head, pastel-blue sailor uniform, yellow jacket, bracelets and waist key collection. Do not hold an open palm out.

Calm rational Sho, the aspiring doctor, gives a measured firm nod. Torso turned slightly toward screen-right, chin level. His RIGHT hand holds a small penlight upright close to his sternum between thumb and fingers, LEFT hand calmly supports the right wrist near mid-torso. Steady thoughtful eyes, mouth slightly open as if explaining a precise fact, not a smile or a pointed accusation. Preserve ash-blond hair, green eyes, cheek bandages, gray blazer/cable-knit vest, loosened teal tie and bandaged hands.

Taciturn loyal Satsuki acknowledges her ally with a restrained confident nod. Both arms are CROSSED at chest height, right hand resting visibly over her left upper arm, shoulders squared, chin slightly raised. Her eyes look toward screen-right, expression calm and resolute rather than hostile. Preserve green-black hair, side braid and feather, lilac eyes, black scarf, tan blazer and brown leather forearm guards. No props and absolutely no outward open-palm arm.

Cool and formally polite Rei confirms a conclusion with reserved precision. His torso is turned toward screen-right. RIGHT gloved hand carefully straightens the LEFT sleeve cuff close to his waist, left forearm angled diagonally across his stomach; shoulders upright and composed. A tiny serious nod, level lavender gaze from the visible eye. Preserve white hair over the same eye, white stand-collar long uniform with black piping and silver chain, black gloves and exact costume details. No new object, no palm held toward camera.

Bright, courageous Sora confirms his ally with a proud warm grin and strong shoulders. LEFT fist gently pressed over his heart, RIGHT hand relaxed on his belt/hip; torso leaning forward a little toward screen-right. Friendly conviction, not punching or pointing. Preserve his blond tousled hair and ahoge, red headband, orange safety-striped jacket, dark shirt and work belt. No new prop.

Theatrical, mischievously perceptive Ken agrees with an amused knowing half-smile. Torso in a poised three-quarter turn toward screen-right; RIGHT gloved thumb lightly brushes his lower lip while that elbow is supported by the LEFT forearm across his ribs. His right eyebrow lifts subtly, eyes attentive, as if enjoying a clever deduction. Preserve wavy red hair, golden eyes, beauty mark, black shirt/red ribbon, maroon gold-trimmed cape/jacket, white gloves and small comedy-mask accessory on his belt. No open-palm presenting arm.

Gentle considerate Nana summons quiet courage to support her ally. Both hands softly CLASP together near her sternum, fingers naturally intertwined, elbows held near her body. Lean forward a little toward screen-right with an encouraging small smile and earnest open eyes, not a prayer or a pleading scared face. Preserve pale pink-beige long side ponytail, blue flower clips, lilac eyes, cream sailor cardigan and white wrist ribbon. No cup or new prop; no one-arm palm-up gesture.

Playful sharp-eyed magician Riku supports his ally with a confident conspiratorial grin. RIGHT gloved hand performs a clear small COIN roll over his knuckles near chest height, coin visible; LEFT hand lightly tips the brim of his existing miniature black top hat, elbows bent in two different silhouettes. Torso angled toward screen-right with a slight jaunty shoulder tilt. Preserve orange curls, tiny top hat, golden eyes, black standing-collar magician uniform, checked cuffs, white gloves and wine-colored cape. Not a generic outstretched palm.

Sociable band-vocalist Yuu agrees with a lively knowing grin. RIGHT hand lightly hooks/touches one of the headphones resting at his NECK, wrist bent and elbow lifted sideways; LEFT thumb hooks casually at his jacket hem near his hip. His shoulders tilt asymmetrically toward screen-right, bright eyes reacting to his ally. Preserve turquoise spiky hair, lilac eyes, earrings, beige/blue headphones at neck, open navy school jacket, white printed shirt and triangular pendant. No microphone/guitar or outward palm.

Responsible quietly determined class representative Koto supports her ally while keeping the discussion orderly. LEFT arm hugs her plain closed notebook against her lower chest. RIGHT hand is lifted near shoulder with fingers together and palm VERTICAL in a gentle composed moderating gesture, not extended forward palm-up. Slight inclination of the head toward screen-right and a small confident reassuring smile. Preserve very long honey-blond hair, small side bun/flower pin, cream cardigan over dark sailor uniform, red armband, green ribbon, notebook. Hands and notebook entirely visible.

Big muscular protective patrol captain Taiga agrees with rough enthusiastic resolve. His RIGHT fist is enclosed in his LEFT hand at the center of his broad chest, visibly cracking/pressing his knuckles together, elbows apart. Lean his powerful shoulders a little forward toward screen-right, a determined friendly half-grin, not an angry attack. Keep close-cropped dark hair, tan skin, thick eyebrows, open black rolled-sleeve uniform with red armband, white shirt, black martial-arts belt, taped fingers and red whistle on cord. Preserve his big broad physique, not a slim boy. No outward presenting hand.

Quiet observant cook Ai agrees by preparing to act rather than making a speech. RIGHT hand rolls/tugs up the LEFT sleeve at her forearm, left elbow slightly bent across her waist; eyes glance up toward screen-right with a calm certain expression and closed mouth, a tiny decisive nod. Preserve mint bob and straight fringe, pink eyes, white headscarf, pink blouse/dress and white apron with the SAME small magenta/cyan PAINT stains as reference. Fully ordinary closed clothing. No new tool, no palm-up gesture, no cute pleading pose.

Outgoing photographer Haruka agrees with animated friendly confidence. RIGHT hand grips her existing black camera at shoulder height with lens angled slightly away from viewer, LEFT hand grasps its neck/shoulder strap diagonally across her torso near the opposite shoulder, elbows bent asymmetrically. Her torso twists lightly toward screen-right, cheerful spirited open-mouth smile and bright attentive eyes. Preserve pink bob, blue hairclip, brown eyes, tan blazer, white shirt, pink bow, colorful bracelets and camera. Not the old one-arm camera plus open-palm pose.

Cool highly punctual Kaede agrees with restrained self-assurance. She has just checked her wristwatch: LEFT forearm angled across her torso displaying the existing watch, RIGHT fingertips rest lightly at the watch strap, and her head turns back toward screen-right to address her ally, one eyebrow subtly lifted. Her posture is straight and elegant, expression calm and faintly approving. Preserve long blue hair with light streak, snowflake hair ornament, gray-lilac eyes, blue high-neck snowflake-buttoned coat over cream skirt/dress, and watch. No outward palm, no new prop.
